description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with infection prevention and control, ensuring the highest standards of care and staff competency within our facility. You will play a key role in educating our team and safeguarding the health of our residents.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are a proactive and experienced RN with a passion for education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply and contribute to a supportive and dynamic healthcare environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
